app.name: Mon École
app.tagline: One School. One Platform. One Source of Truth.
app.description: Enrolment, finance, attendance and results — all in one place.

auth.idleLogout: You were signed out after a period of inactivity.
auth.forgotSubtitle: Enter your email address and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.linkSent: If an account matches this address, an email is on its way. Remember to check your spam folder.
auth.resetSubtitle: Choose a password of at least 10 characters.

auth.changeDone: Password changed. Your other sessions have been signed out.

auth.emailNotVerified: Confirm your email address first, with the link in the invitation email.
auth.invitationExpired: Your temporary password has expired. Ask your school to send the invitation again.
auth.verifyDone: {{email}} is confirmed. Now sign in with this email and the temporary password from the invitation; you will then choose your own password.

dashboard.subtitle: Here is what matters at {{school}}.
dashboard.setupSubtitle: First steps to prepare your school.
dashboard.setupProfileHint: Logo, contact details, currency and default language.
dashboard.setupUsersHint: Management, office staff, accounts and teachers.
dashboard.setupRolesHint: Adjust what each role is allowed to do.
dashboard.noYear: No school year is set up yet: figures will appear once the year and classes are created.

modules.comingTitle: This module is on its way
modules.comingBody: The “{{module}}” module is part of phase {{phase}} of the project. It will be demonstrated for approval before going live.
modules.enrollments: New enrolments, re-enrolments, supporting documents and a printable enrolment form.
modules.students: A complete file for every student: guardians, academic history, payments, attendance and report cards.
modules.administration: Announcements, school calendar, departments and official documents.
modules.classes: Classes by level and school year, rooms, headcount and class teacher.
modules.subjects: Subjects, codes, coefficients and assigned teachers.
modules.teachers: Staff records, qualifications, assignments and workload.
modules.finance: Tuition fees, invoices, payments, receipts, arrears and expenses.
modules.cashRegister: Opening and closing the till, cash in and out, daily reports.
modules.attendance: Take the register from a phone, lateness, absences and statistics.
modules.assessments: Homework, tests and exams, grade entry and approval.
modules.results: Averages, coefficients, rankings and PDF report cards.

school.name: School name

users.inviteExplained: They will receive an email with a link to confirm their address and a temporary password (valid 7 days). At first sign-in they choose their own password.
users.directorLocked: Only the platform owner can change a Director's roles.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.subtitle: Each user has one or more roles; a role groups permissions.
roles.name: Role name
roles.directorLocked: The Director always has every permission.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every important action: who, what, when and from where.

academics.yearsHint: The current year is used by default everywhere in the app.
academics.name: Name
academics.confirmDeleteYear: Delete the year {{name}}? Not possible if classes belong to it.
academics.levelsHint: Levels group classes (e.g. Grade 7 → Grade 7A, Grade 7B).
academics.noYears: No school year yet. Create the first one to open classes.
academics.noYearWarning: No school year has been set up yet.

classes.subtitle: This year's classes, headcounts and class teachers.

classes.capacityHint: Maximum number of students. Leave empty for no limit.
classes.confirmDelete: Delete the class {{name}}? Not possible once students have been enrolled.
classes.subject: Subject
classes.noSubjectsAssigned: No subjects assigned to this class yet.
classes.noStudents: No students enrolled in this class.

subjects.name: Name
subjects.coefficientHint: Suggested when assigning to a class; can be changed class by class.
subjects.confirmDelete: Delete the subject {{name}}? Not possible while it is taught in a class.

staff.title: Teachers & staff
staff.subtitle: Staff records, assignments and app access.
staff.grantAccessBody: An invitation will be sent to {{email}} to choose a password.
staff.needsEmail: Add an email address to this record first.
staff.confirmArchive: Archive {{name}}'s record? Their history is kept.
staff.addHint: They receive an email to confirm their address and a temporary password to sign in.
staff.inviteExplained: The verification link and the temporary password are valid 7 days; at first sign-in they choose their own password.
staff.createdInvited: Staff member added. Invitation sent to {{email}}.
staff.subject: Subject
staff.noSubjectsYet: No subjects yet. Add one row per class and subject.
staff.teachingNoYear: Set up the current school year first to assign classes.
staff.teachingNoClasses: Create this year's classes first to assign them.
staff.teachingHint: The class they lead and the subjects they teach this year. Another teacher already on one of these is replaced.

enrollments.withdrawBody: {{name}} is leaving the school. The record is kept.
enrollments.cancelBody: Only for an enrolment made by mistake.
enrollments.studentNumberHint: Leave empty to assign one automatically.
enrollments.successBody: {{name}} is enrolled in {{class}} for {{year}} — student no. {{number}}.
enrollments.noGuardiansWarning: No parent or guardian given. You can add them later.
enrollments.guardiansExisting: Parents already recorded for this student:

enrollments.needNextYear: Create next school year and its classes first.

documents.title: Documents
documents.fileHint: PDF, JPEG, PNG or WebP — 10 MB maximum.

imports.subtitle: Bring in your existing Excel lists in a few minutes.
imports.step1Body: Fill in one row per person. Columns marked * are required; your own French or English headers are recognised too.
imports.step2Body: Nothing is saved at this step: we point out every row to fix.
imports.fixAndRetry: Fix these rows in your file, then check it again. Nothing has been saved.

search.placeholder: Search a student, parent, teacher, class…

finance.title: Finance
finance.subtitle: Fees, invoices, payments, discounts and what each student owes.
finance.invoicesIntro: Invoices are issued automatically when a student is enrolled, from the fees set up for their level.
finance.generateHint: Issues this year's fees to every enrolled student who does not have an enrolment invoice yet — for example after setting up the fees.
finance.withoutFees_one: {{count}} student is in a level with no fees set up for this year.
finance.withoutFees_other: {{count}} students are in levels with no fees set up for this year.
finance.newInvoiceHint: An extra charge for one student: uniform, exam fee, books…
finance.searchInvoices: Search by number, student name or ID…
finance.noInvoicesHint: Set up the fees in “Fee set-up”, then issue the invoices of students already enrolled.
finance.discountTooLarge: The discount cannot be larger than the amount.
finance.cancelInvoiceHint: The invoice stays on record, marked as cancelled. Issue a new one if the amounts were wrong.
finance.categoriesHint: The kinds of fees the school charges. Click one to edit it.
finance.noCategories: No fee categories yet. Start with registration and tuition.
finance.schedulesHint: What each level pays this year, and when each installment is due.
finance.noFees: No fees for this level yet.
finance.feeHint: Invoices already issued keep their amounts; changes apply to new invoices.
finance.installmentsMismatch: The installments must add up to the fee amount.
finance.confirmDeleteFee: Delete the fee “{{name}}” for this level? Invoices already issued are not changed.
finance.discountsIntro: Scholarships, sibling and staff-child reductions. They apply to invoices issued afterwards.
finance.discountHint: A reduction for one student and one school year.
finance.percentMax: A percentage cannot be more than 100.
finance.fixedNeedsCategory: Choose the fee a fixed amount applies to.
finance.discountAppliesLater: The discount applies to invoices issued from now on. To change an invoice already issued, cancel it and issue it again.
finance.noStudentInvoices: No invoices for this student yet.
finance.paymentsIntro: Every payment received, with its receipt. A payment recorded by mistake is reversed, never deleted.
finance.recordPaymentHint: Money received for a student. It pays their oldest unpaid fees first.
finance.searchPayments: Search by receipt no., reference, student…
finance.noPaymentsHint: Record a payment from here, from a student's “Payments” tab or from an invoice.
finance.referenceHint: Transaction ID, bank slip or cheque number.
finance.payerPlaceholder: Parent or guardian who brought the money
finance.noFutureDate: A payment cannot be dated in the future.
finance.oldestFirstHint: The oldest unpaid fees are paid first.
finance.nothingDue: Nothing is due: the whole amount is kept as credit for the next invoice.
finance.moreThanDue: A fee cannot receive more than is still due on it.
finance.moreThanPayment: The fees paid add up to more than the payment.
finance.reversePaymentHint: The payment stays on record, marked as reversed, and no longer pays its fees. Its receipt is cancelled. Record the right payment afterwards if needed.
finance.nothingAllocated: Nothing: the whole amount was kept as credit.
finance.expensesIntro: What the school spends. An expense paid in cash leaves the open register.
finance.noExpensesHint: Record the school's spending here to follow it in the reports.
finance.cancelExpenseHint: The expense stays on record, marked as cancelled. Cash paid out goes back into the register.
finance.refundHint: Give back to the family of {{name}} part or all of their credit ({{amount}}).
finance.cancelRefundHint: The refund stays on record, marked as cancelled, and the credit comes back to the student.

platform.title: All schools
platform.subtitle: Every school on Mon École. Register a school with its Director, open any school, or suspend one.
platform.registerHint: The Director receives an invitation email with a verification link and a temporary password.
platform.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, e.g. horizon.
platform.codeFormat: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes only.
platform.languageHint: Default language of the school's screens and emails.
platform.inviteExplained: The Director confirms their email with the link, signs in with the temporary password, then chooses their own. Both are valid 7 days.
platform.confirmSuspend: Suspend {{name}}? Nobody from this school can sign in until you reactivate it. No data is deleted.
platform.noSchoolsHint: Register the first school and its Director.

cash.subtitle: Open the till with a float, follow the cash in and out, and close it with a count.
cash.noOpenRegister: No cash register is open, so cash cannot be taken yet.
cash.openHint: Count the cash in the till before the first payment of the day.
cash.closeHint: Count the cash in the till. Any difference with what is expected must be explained.
cash.balanced: The count matches what is expected.
cash.movementHint: Cash in or out that is not a payment, an expense or a refund.
cash.registerHint: A cash box, such as the main till or a second desk.
cash.noSessionsHint: Open the register before taking the first cash payment.
cash.noMovements: No cash has come in or gone out yet.
